title: Cyrus decrees the return of the Jews
summary: Cyrus, king of Persia, proclaims that the Jews may return to Jerusalem and rebuild the house of the LORD.
description: CFAH-1 Table 1 row "Cyrus Decree of Return" (536 BC, the Ussher-Jones baseline adopted by CFAH). CFAH-1 treats the Ussher-Jones chronology as the most consistent reading of the biblical data before this decree. Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 baseline: 536 BC (Cyrus Decree of Return)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.
